content_zh:
“哼，吕布小儿不识抬举，妄图与本太师做对，本太师有文优相助，何愁天下不能定。”董卓志得意满的说道。
“太师之功，无人能比，废帝而另立新君，必定震慑诸臣，让天下群雄臣服。”李儒附和道。
“哈哈，好，来日宴请群臣，再议废帝之事。”董卓大笑道，另择明君而立，是汉朝臣子权力最高的体现，如大将军霍光，权倾一时。
次日，董卓上表举荐上党太守为并州牧，总管并州军政，同时任命吕布为九原太守，立即引兵回九原
刘辩战战兢兢的看着嚣张跋扈发号施令的董卓，求助的看向朝中大臣，还是少年的他，已经怕了行径野蛮的董卓。
而经过最近一段时间董卓的血腥清理，朝中哪还有人敢于和董卓当面理论，只能唯唯诺诺。
见朝中君臣的反应，董卓大笑不已。
连番的交战，丁原带来的四万并州军，此时只剩下一万八千多人，经过深思熟虑，吕布决定施展精兵计划，当日夜袭，如果不是自家兵马先乱了阵脚，岂能被华雄轻易得逞，总而言之，还是士卒的训练不够，面对偷袭，各部将领不能有效的组织人马抵抗。
现在最缺少的就是时间，如果给他一年的时间，他确信能够训练出一支精锐。
身披缟素，吕布跪坐在帐内上首的位置，虽然他很想就此带领军马回到并州，但丁原的仇没报，此时回军，定然会让手下的将领心寒，而且丁原待他不薄，自己这关他都过不去。
“丁刺史不幸身亡，在下被众位推举为军中首领，深感责任重大；朝廷任命我为九原太守，即日返回九原，任命张扬为并州牧，统领并州军政。”吕布说完环视了一眼左右，见众人议论纷纷，话锋一转道：“不过当前我认为最要紧的事情有三个。”
众将停止了议论，将目光投向吕布。
“第一，为丁刺史报仇。”
“第二，稳定并州。”
“第三，练兵备战。”
见吕布将为丁原报仇放在首位，不少将领放了心，丁原平时待人宽厚，很得将领爱戴，很多人也没将张扬放在眼里，别看他现在是并州牧，等大军回到并州，还不是谁拳头大谁说的算。
“诺。”众将齐声道。
“经过连番大战，并州军伤亡惨重，现在我将并州军分为四部三骑，张辽率领狼骑一千人，损失的兵马从军中优先挑选。”
“诺”张辽喜出望外，狼骑可是吕布组建的第一支骑兵，战斗力十分彪悍，与西凉军骑兵的交战中稳稳的占据上风。
“曹性组建虎卫，为虎卫统领，所部为一千骑兵，负责保卫中军安全，所部兵马优先从士卒中挑选，多派人手打探雒阳和大军周边的消息，有什么风吹草动，要及时上报。”

“诺。”曹性出列道。
“成廉组建骁骑营，为骁骑统领，所部为一千骑兵，可先行从士卒中挑选。”
“诺。”成廉咧嘴一笑，抱拳应道。
“高顺继续统领陷阵营，所部八百人马不变，所需军械、士兵的挑选不可怠慢。”
“诺。”
“郝萌、魏续、宋宪、侯成，各领两千名步兵，挑选士卒中的精壮进行训练。”
“诺。”四人齐声道。
“好，希望你们能够带领自己的士兵，训练出成绩来，半月之后，我会对各部进行考核，不合格的将领直接换掉。”吕布道。
众人闻言心中一震，刚才被点到的将领，可以说是吕布的绝对心腹，在军中的地位也不低，所以刚才没有人反对；之前丁原也一直着力培养吕布，似张辽高顺等人都在军中重要的位置上，所以丁原死后，有吕布统领，并州军中没有出现其他声音。
“文远，你带领一千狼骑带领余下的兵马返回并州。”待众人离开后，吕布对张辽说道。
“将军，卑职愿跟随将军左右杀敌，为刺史大人报仇。”张辽抱拳道。
“文远，并州乃是我军的根基所在，并州不稳，则军心不稳，希望你回到并州之后，能够尽快将九原稳定下来，莫让敌人断了我军的后路，同时催促张扬押运粮草，张扬刚刚执掌并州，定然不会怠慢。”吕布拍了拍张辽的肩膀语重心长的说道：“朝廷任命上党太守张扬为并州牧，你此次回去，不可与其发生冲突，待我返回并州之后再做定夺。”

"Humph, Lu Bu is a kid who doesn't know how to praise me, and he is trying to go against me. I have literary talents to help me, so why worry about the world being uncertain." Dong Zhuozhi said proudly.
"The achievements of the Grand Master are unparalleled. To depose the emperor and establish a new king will definitely shock the ministers and make all the heroes in the world surrender." Li Ru agreed.
"Haha, okay, let's have a banquet with all the ministers in the future and discuss the dethronement of the emperor." Dong Zhuo laughed and said, choosing another Ming emperor was the highest manifestation of the power of the officials of the Han Dynasty, such as the general Huo Guang, who had overwhelming power for a while.
The next day, Dong Zhuo recommended the governor of Shangdang as the governor of Bingzhou, in charge of the military affairs of Bingzhou. At the same time, he appointed Lu Bu as the governor of Jiuyuan, and immediately led his troops back to Jiuyuan.
Liu Bian looked at Dong Zhuo who was arrogant and domineering and giving orders with trepidation, and looked at the ministers for help. As a young man, he was already afraid of Dong Zhuo's barbaric behavior.
After Dong Zhuo's bloody purge in the recent period, no one in the court dared to argue with Dong Zhuo face to face, so they could only obey.
Seeing the reactions of the emperor and his ministers, Dong Zhuo burst out laughing.
After repeated battles, only more than 18,000 of the 40,000 Bingzhou troops brought by Ding Yuan were left. After careful consideration, Lu Bu decided to launch a plan of elite troops and attack at night. If his own troops had not been disrupted first, how could Hua Xiong have succeeded so easily. In short, the soldiers were not trained enough. In the face of a sneak attack, the generals could not effectively organize their troops to resist.
The most lacking thing now is time. If he is given a year, he is sure that he can train an elite team.
Dressed in silk, Lu Bu knelt and sat at the top of the tent. Although he wanted to lead his troops back to Bingzhou, Ding Yuan's revenge had not been avenged. Returning to the army at this time would definitely make his generals feel chilled. Moreover, Ding Yuan treated him so well that he could not even get through it himself.
"Unfortunately, Inspector Ding died. I was elected by everyone to be the leader of the army. I feel the great responsibility. The imperial court appointed me as the governor of Jiuyuan. I will return to Jiuyuan today and appoint Zhang Yang as the shepherd of Bingzhou to lead the military and administration of Bingzhou." After Lu Bu finished speaking, he looked around and saw everyone talking about it. He changed the subject and said, "But I think there are three most important things at the moment."
The generals stopped talking and turned their attention to Lu Bu.
"First, avenge Governor Ding."
"Second, stabilize the union of states."
"Third, train troops and prepare for war."
Seeing that Lu Bu prioritized revenge for Ding Yuan, many generals felt relieved. Ding Yuan was usually kind and generous to others and was loved by the generals. Many people did not take Zhang Yang seriously. Even though he was now the shepherd of Bingzhou, when the army returned to Bingzhou, whoever had the bigger fist would have the final say.
"No." All the generals said in unison.
"After successive battles, the Bingzhou Army suffered heavy casualties. Now I will divide the Bingzhou Army into four groups and three cavalry. Zhang Liao will lead a thousand wolf cavalry. The lost soldiers and horses will be selected first from the army."
"Nuo" Zhang Liao was overjoyed. The Wolf Cavalry was the first cavalry formed by Lu Bu. It was very powerful in combat and firmly had the upper hand in the battle with the Xiliang Army's cavalry.
"Cao Xing formed the Tiger Guard and was the commander of the Tiger Guard. He had a thousand cavalry under his command and was responsible for protecting the safety of the central army. The troops and horses under his command were selected first among the soldiers. He sent more people to inquire about the news around Luoyang and the army. If there is any disturbance, they must report it in time."
"No." Cao Xing came out and said.
"Cheng Lian established a heroic cavalry camp and led the heroic cavalry. There are a thousand cavalry under his command. He can be selected from among the soldiers first."
"No." Cheng Lian grinned and answered with his fists clasped.
"Gao Shun continues to lead the trapped camp, and his 800 troops remain unchanged. The selection of required ordnance and soldiers must not be neglected."
"No."
"Hao Meng, Wei Xu, Song Xian, and Hou Cheng each led 2,000 infantrymen and selected the best among them for training."
"No." The four of them said in unison.
"Okay, I hope you can lead your soldiers and train to achieve results. After half a month, I will conduct an assessment on each department and replace the unqualified generals directly." Lu Bu said.
Everyone was shocked when they heard this. The general who was named just now couldIt was said that he was Lu Bu's absolute confidant and his status in the army was not low, so no one objected just now. Ding Yuan had also been trying to train Lu Bu before, and Zhang Liao, Gao Shun and others all held important positions in the army. Therefore, after Ding Yuan's death, Lu Bu was in charge, and there were no other voices in the Bingzhou army.
"Wenyuan, you lead a thousand wolf cavalry and the remaining troops back to Bingzhou." After everyone left, Lu Bu said to Zhang Liao.
"General, I am willing to follow the general to kill the enemy and avenge the governor." Zhang Liao said with fists in his hands.
"Wenyuan, Bingzhou is the foundation of our army. If Bingzhou is not stable, the morale of the army will be unstable. I hope that after you return to Bingzhou, you can stabilize Jiuyuan as soon as possible and not let the enemy cut off our army's retreat. At the same time, you urge Zhang Yang to escort the grain and grass. Zhang Yang just I will definitely not neglect you when I take charge of Bingzhou." Lu Bu patted Zhang Liao on the shoulder and said sincerely: "The imperial court appointed Zhang Yang, the governor of Shangdang, as the shepherd of Bingzhou. You must not conflict with him when you return. I will make a decision after I return to Bingzhou."
